rca of the issue: Original production symptom (524 around 1 minute) is consistent with request-time heavy balance aggregation on /api/admin/labels. Current implementation moves source-of-truth aggregation into background materialization (snapshot) and serves list from stored balance_available_idr, while keeping detail/source parity via refresh + status workflow. No unresolved failures reproduced in this preview run. No API is MOCKED in application flow; only Playwright network interception was used for failure-state simulation.
